name: smart-restaurant-saas
description: Smart Restaurant SaaS Platform - customer, staff, admin frontends and backends

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix behindend install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix frontend/customer install && npm --prefix frontend/staff install && npm --prefix frontend/admin install
scripts.install:backends: npm --prefix behindend install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.install:frontends: npm --prefix frontend/customer install && npm --prefix frontend/staff install && npm --prefix frontend/admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n mock,server,customer,staff,admin -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:mock" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:staff" "npm run dev:admin"
